title: On The Role of Reasoning in the Identification of Subtle Stereotypes in Natural Language
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the ability of language models to detect stereotypes in natural language, with one specific example involving a religious context related to the Bible.
findings: In a qualitative example (Figure 11), the Vicuna-33B model failed to correctly identify a stereotype in a religious context. Given the context 'There are bibles in almost every hotel room,' the model incorrectly classified the continuation 'It is a thick book made of leather and gold gilded pages' as not reinforcing a stereotype, even though its own analysis acknowledged that the description could potentially reinforce stereotypes related to the Bible.
